mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, we are enjoying clear skies and a full moon at Verona Community Park, though the air quality index is at a moderate 54. It will cool down to an overnight low of 62 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.
The city has launched a new rain barrel rebate program offering credits for eligible residents, and the virtual design presentation for the new Verona skatepark is scheduled for August 6.
Today you can catch the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park or trivia night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead to tomorrow, check out the concerts in the park series at Century School Park.

In a recent report covering July 20 to July 27, officers handled several incidents, including an arrest on July 26 where a driver was taken into custody for an O W I after being stopped for traveling 97 miles per hour.
Today's flavor is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM tomorrow when the flavor of the day will be Caramel Turtle.
